import subprocess,json
head=subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip(); branch=subprocess.check_output(["git","branch","--show-current"],text=True).strip(); upstream=subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","--abbrev-ref","@{upstream}"],text=True).strip(); remote=subprocess.check_output(["git","ls-remote","origin","refs/heads/"+branch],text=True).split()[0]; assert head==remote; assert not subprocess.check_output(["git","status","--porcelain"]); print(json.dumps({"candidateCodeHead":head,"branch":branch,"upstream":upstream,"actualRemoteHead":remote,"cleanCodeBeforeReport":True},indent=2))
